recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17056 unless a future work group decision changes Bundle.total semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17056 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed clarification from the STU3 ballot asking the Bundle.total definition to replace the vague count of search matches with wording that counts entries of type 'match' across all pages, excludes include and outcome entries, and is not just the number of entries in the current Bundle.
initial_application: The Jira comment says svn 14368. Git commit 2a9d92faa72912b0b7ed10f9b5c27b80dfc0c2e5 imports that application as 'GF#17056 - fix definition' and changes source/bundle/bundle-spreadsheet.xml from the old wording to the requested match/include/outcome wording. Later source refactors preserved the clarification in source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml defines Bundle.total as the potentially estimated total number of entries of type 'match' across all pages while excluding search.mode include and outcome entries and Bundle entry counts. FHIR-33942 later approved the potentially estimated qualifier, and FHIR-48485 later retained the search/history restriction with added rationale, so current wording is a later-refined version of the FHIR-17056 clarification rather than a mismatch.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current build-scope Bundle.total definition and nearby search narrative already convey the requested implementer-facing rule.
